hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: Enforces a fixed 1% swap fee on all swaps, split 0.7% to the pool creator and 0.3% to the platform, collected via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwap return deltas. Liquidity is locked permanently after an initial seed — subsequent adds revert and removes always revert — and pools must be registered by the owner before swaps are permitted.
